---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an enhancement to the accelerator
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

**What problem does this solve?**
A clear description of the gap or use case (e.g. a new smart-community scenario, an extra
lab, a new dataset, an app improvement).

**Proposed change**
What you'd like to see added or changed.

**Scope / impact**
Which labs, generator tables, Genie context, or app components would this touch?

**Data policy check**
- [ ] The change uses **synthetic data only** (no customer data, PII, or proprietary data)
- [ ] The change stays **provider-neutral** (no specific telco/ISP brands or real PLMNs)

**Additional context**
Mockups, links, or references.
